zh: 鼠标悬停到上方任意升级按钮，可查看该项的详细公式与生效方式。
en: Hover over any upgrade button above to see its exact formula and effect.

zh:
生命强化（局外常驻）
公式：MaxHP = 140 + 14 * 等级
影响：开局直接增加最大生命值与当前生命值。
en:
Vitality (permanent)
Formula: MaxHP = 140 + 14 * level
Effect: start each run with more max HP and current HP.

zh:
攻击强化（局外常驻）
公式：子弹基础伤害 = 18 + 3 * 等级
影响：提升常规射击伤害（不改变光剑伤害）。
en:
Attack (permanent)
Formula: base bullet damage = 18 + 3 * level
Effect: boosts regular shot damage (does not affect the light sword).

zh:
机动强化（局外常驻）
公式：移速倍率 = 1.0 + 0.03 * 等级
影响：提升基础移动速度，冲刺速度本身由其他词条控制。
en:
Mobility (permanent)
Formula: move speed multiplier = 1.0 + 0.03 * level
Effect: raises base move speed; dash speed is governed by other upgrades.

zh:
魔力增幅（局外常驻）
公式：魔法基础倍率 = 1.0 + 0.12 * 等级
影响：提升奥术飞弹/霜环爆发的基础伤害系数。
en:
Magic Power (permanent)
Formula: base magic multiplier = 1.0 + 0.12 * level
Effect: raises the base damage of Arcane Missile and Frost Nova.

zh:
近战流分支（光剑定向）
公式：光剑伤害 += 5 * 等级，光剑半径 += 4 * 等级
影响：近战扫荒能力更强，清怪圈更大。
en:
Melee Path (light sword focus)
Formula: sword damage += 5 * level, sword radius += 4 * level
Effect: stronger melee sweeps with a wider clearing circle.

zh:
射击流分支（弹道定向）
公式：子弹伤害 += 4 * 等级，弹速 += 18 * 等级，射击CD倍率 = max(0.72, 1 - 0.025 * 等级)
影响：远程火力与命中感提升。
en:
Ranged Path (ballistic focus)
Formula: bullet damage += 4 * level, bullet speed += 18 * level, fire CD multiplier = max(0.72, 1 - 0.025 * level)
Effect: more ranged firepower and snappier hits.

zh:
法术流分支（技能定向）
公式：法术伤害倍率 *= (1 + 0.14 * 等级)，法术频率倍率 = 1 + 0.08 * 等级
影响：法术更疼、触发更快，对法术体系提升最直接。
en:
Spell Path (skill focus)
Formula: spell damage multiplier *= (1 + 0.14 * level), spell rate multiplier = 1 + 0.08 * level
Effect: spells hit harder and trigger faster - the most direct boost for spell builds.

zh:
奥术飞弹（解锁技能）
触发：自动索敌周期施放
效果：对最近敌人造成单体魔法伤害，法术分支可进一步强化。
en:
Arcane Missile (unlockable skill)
Trigger: auto-targets and casts periodically
Effect: deals single-target magic damage to the nearest enemy; further boosted by the Spell Path.

zh:
霜环爆发（解锁技能）
触发：自动周期环形施放
效果：对身边范围敌人造成伤害并击退，适合解围。
en:
Frost Nova (unlockable skill)
Trigger: periodic ring cast around you
Effect: damages and knocks back nearby enemies - great for breaking out of a swarm.

en: Controls: auto light sword + auto fire (locks onto enemies) | 1/2/3/4/5 switch bullets (Q to cycle) | Right-click shield | Shift dash

en: Chaser: rushes you in melee, with a short wind-up before pouncing.

en: Dasher: charges at you; telegraphed by a straight purple line.

en: Sniper: fires long-range shots along a yellow line. High damage.

zh: 炮击手：三连散射，橙色多条预警。
en: Artillery: fires three-shot spreads, telegraphed by several orange lines.

zh: 绿线：普通远程射击（射手）
黄线：狙击蓄力射击（狙击手）
橙线：扼形三连弹幕（炮击手）
金线：图腾蓄力炮击（Boss机制）
en: Gold line: charged totem blast (boss mechanic)

zh:
子弹系统：按 1/2/3/4/5 直切模式，Q 循环切换。
普通：稳定点射，适合常规清杂。
刺穿：直线穿透，克制前排堆叠与狭长走廊。
爆裂：近中距面伤，适合贴脸怪群与转角压制。
反弹：对机动目标与边角战场更有效，能借地形补刀。
咒弹：附带追踪与连锁特性，适合打高价值单位与后排。
建议：开怪先用刺穿压线，近身潮切爆裂，残局改反弹/咒弹追击。
en:
Bullets: press 1/2/3/4/5 to pick a mode directly, or Q to cycle.
Normal: steady shots, good for general clearing.
Pierce: passes through enemies in a line; counters packed front lines and narrow corridors.
Burst: area damage at close-to-mid range; great against swarms in your face and around corners.
Ricochet: better against mobile targets and in corners; bounces off terrain to finish enemies.
Hex: homing and chaining; ideal for high-value targets and back lines.
Tip: open with Pierce to hold the line, swap to Burst when swarmed, then finish with Ricochet/Hex.

zh: 防御与位移：右键护盾消耗 SP，Shift 突进可用于规避狙击与弹幕。
en: Defense & movement: hold right-click for a shield that drains SP; Shift dashes to dodge sniper shots and barrages.

zh: 主要输出体系：光剑自动输出 + 子弹模式切换，波次间通过卡片逐渐成型。
en: Damage sources: the light sword attacks automatically while you switch bullet modes; your build takes shape through cards between waves.

zh: 波次节奏：预览 -> 战斗 -> 结算选牌，每 5 波将出现小 Boss 机制。
en: Wave rhythm: preview -> combat -> pick a card. A mini-boss appears every 5 waves.

zh: 局外成长：本局得分转化为可用分数，在“激发潜能”中解锁分支成长与魔法。
en: Meta progression: your run score becomes spendable points - use them in "Potential" to unlock growth branches and magic.

zh: 光剑：自动 360° 扫击，可提升半径/间隔/旋转速度。
en: Light sword: auto 360-degree sweep; upgrade its radius, interval and spin speed.

zh: 护盾：按住右键开启，消耗 SP；关闭后逐渐回复。
en: Shield: hold right-click to raise it, draining SP; SP regenerates when it is down.

zh: 突进：Shift 向移动方向位移，可升级距离与冷却。
en: Dash: Shift dashes in your movement direction; upgrade distance and cooldown.

zh: 技能说明：当前版本以子弹/光剑/法术为核心，本条为预留概览说明位。
en: Skills: this version centers on bullets, the light sword and spells; this entry is a placeholder overview.

zh: 战斗得分：击杀基础分 * 波次乘区（x1 + 波次*0.15）。
en: Score: base kill points * wave multiplier (x1 + wave * 0.15).

zh: 额外发射两发侧向子弹
突进触发震荡波（伤害+范围）
光剑额外触发回响斩击概率 +22%
反弹模式可额外反射 +1 次

en: Hex bullets home in more strongly

zh: 解锁连锁法印：自动在敌人间跳转造成多段伤害；优先锁定“咒印”目标，并消耗咒印提升伤害。
en: Unlocks Chain Sigil: automatically jumps between enemies for multi-hit damage; prioritizes Hex-marked targets and consumes the mark for bonus damage.

zh: 解锁陈星雨：自动连续降下多次冲击，优先锁定“咒印”目标，并消耗咒印增加落点与伤害。
en: Unlocks Starfall: automatically rains down a series of impacts; prioritizes Hex-marked targets and consumes the mark for more strikes and damage.

zh: 每次陈星雨额外+1次落点
流星基础伤害+9，法强小幅提升

en: Each meteor triggers 1 extra aftershock explosion on landing

zh: 流星命中积累共鸣，强化下一轮连锁法印（伤害+跳转）
en: Meteor hits build resonance that empowers your next Chain Sigil (damage + jumps)

zh: 流星转为高频散落分支：落点数大幅提升、每发伤害与半径降低（与“砸星坐落”互斥）
en: Meteors become a rapid shower: many more strikes, but less damage and radius each (exclusive with "Star Crash")

zh: 流星转为巨陨冲击分支：落点数降低但每发爆炸范围与伤害大幅提升（与“星雨散落”互斥）
en: Meteors become giant impacts: fewer strikes, but much bigger blasts and damage (exclusive with "Star Shower")

zh: 光剑转为风刃流：半径与旋速大幅提升，伤害小幅降低，会追加二段旋斩（与“断首式”互斥）
en: Light sword becomes a gale blade: much larger radius and spin speed, slightly less damage, adds a second spin slash (exclusive with "Beheader")

zh: 光剑转为斩杀流：单次伤害大幅提升，对低血敌人追加处决伤害（与“风刃舞”互斥）
en: Light sword becomes an executioner: much higher hit damage, plus bonus execute damage to low-HP enemies (exclusive with "Gale Dance")

zh: 射击转为高频弹幕：射速提升、伤害降低，额外随机追发一发压制弹（与“轨道贯穿”互斥）
en: Shooting becomes a rapid barrage: higher fire rate, lower damage, plus a random extra suppression shot (exclusive with "Rail Pierce")

zh: 射击转为轨道炉心：弹速与单发伤害大幅提升，射速下降，Burst模式压缩为高能单发（与“弹幕压制”互斥）
en: Shooting becomes a rail core: much higher bullet speed and per-shot damage, lower fire rate; Burst mode fires a single high-energy shot (exclusive with "Suppressing Barrage")

zh: 剑伤害/规模/转速大幅提升，但射击节奏变慢（流派互斥）
en: Huge boost to sword damage/size/spin speed, but slower shooting (locks your school)

zh: 射击伤害/弹速/频率提升，但近战与护盾效率下降（流派互斥）

zh: 直接解锁连锁/降星且强化法术，但常规火力下降（流派互斥）
en: Instantly unlocks Chain Sigil/Starfall and empowers spells, but lowers regular firepower (locks your school)

zh: 冲刺与手雷体系爆发，但光剑伤害降低（流派互斥）
en: Dash and grenade builds explode in power, but light sword damage drops (locks your school)

zh: 获得 1 个弹道插槽（可安装子弹增幅）

zh: 获得 1 个法术插槽（可安装法术增幅）

en: While your shield is empty, spell rate and light sword damage go up

zh: 6秒内3次突进触发增幅：射击弹速/伤害与手雷伤害提升
